entries.feedback: Never modify Airtable without my permission, even in auto mode; guide me through the changes as the skill runs.
entries.change: SKILL.md Steps 5-6: step-by-step walkthrough with a question per step; build_writes.py only takes explicit item numbers and has no approve-all switch.

entries.feedback: All repositories in Ersilia need to have a description; check that too.
entries.change: rules.json repositories.require_description = true; plan_sync.check_description flags repos with no GitHub description (with the gh command when Airtable has one) and urgently when both are empty.

entries.feedback: I will give feedback every time I use this skill, so it must improve itself; script as much as possible.
entries.change: SKILL.md Step 8 feedback loop; record_feedback.py log read at pre-flight; policy moved into rules.json.

entries.feedback: Rules for Step 3: rows whose repo is gone should be proposed for deletion; missing GitHub descriptions should be offered as a gh command to run; on a Status/Type mismatch, ask me which side is right.
entries.change: rules.json repositories: gone_repo_action=propose_delete, github_description_action=propose, status_type_mismatch=ask. New plan actions delete/github/choice; build_writes --choose; apply_github.py runs approved gh commands and reads the values back.

entries.feedback: Script as much as possible (applied during the first run).
entries.change: African collaboration and Senior are computed from OpenAlex author countries and author positions instead of being judged; existing rows with an empty African collaboration get a fill proposal.

entries.feedback: Archived repos are read-only on GitHub: ignore them for the GitHub-description check.
entries.change: rules.json repositories.description_skip_archived = true; check_description skips archived repos.

entries.feedback: rafiki-workshop was recreated as rafiki-workshop-2026: merge into the curated row rather than create a duplicate and delete the old one.
entries.change: plan_sync.infer_renames (rules.json repositories.infer_renames = true): a gone row plus an untracked repo with the same creation date and description or name prefix becomes a Name update.

entries.feedback: Approved during the run: use the full post URL from the feed, not the bare id (welcoming-claude-at-ersilia).
entries.change: rules.json blogposts.prefer_feed_url = true; plan_sync proposes the feed's canonical URL when the stored one differs.

entries.feedback: Make sure this skill is clean and well done.
entries.change: Independent review, 11 fixes: repeated item numbers no longer double-write; select values are validated against CHOICES and typecast is set only for a new Publication Year; rejections are saved only after a run validates; choice sides renamed use-airtable/use-github; a published version suppresses rival fills and is flagged if its DOI already has a row; publication URLs never swapped for personal ones; renames never pair a row whose repo still exists; normaliser handles plain-id links and refuses name-keyed cells; review steps show values in full; stale docstrings fixed.
